desc: It has a shorter length of pull for smaller shooters to make it more comfortable to carry and shoot. It has a mid-rib delete trim to trim weight from the muzzle to make it easier to shoulder and swing. Using the same CNC machined action as other CZ-USA shotguns, the Quail features a single selectable trigger, extractors, a 28" barrel which features a flat vent rib. Additionally a Turkish walnut stock with pistol grip and laser-cut checkering rounds out the list of features. The Quail comes with a full set of five interchangeable flush choke tubes.
